caveats.already_trained: google/vit-base-patch16-224 ships a 1000-class classifier, so with num_labels=1000 nothing is reinitialised and the 'no training' arms start from a converged model at 78.44% top-1.
caveats.magnitude_quota: The sliced magnitude arm uses a uniform per-layer quota, because slice_heads() requires one and the comparison holds size fixed. magnitude_global is the published global ranking, evaluated by masking.
caveats.recovery_is_the_strong_arm: Most of what post-hoc pruning papers report comes from recovery fine-tuning, so it gets the same optimiser, schedule and data order as the SAL arms.
